subject: prog-cont
title: PROG.CONT.------(P)DOC.
description: Diagram opening R(AS)CM(I)-32 — the section on alternative recording by musicians themselves (Jazz Composer's Orchestra, Strata East, etc.). The prose below the diagram identifies the structural ground: 'The complexity of the contemporary music business is also related to the emergence of alternative recording by the musicians themselves... it was clear that no assistance would be coming from the established recording companies.' The crossing diagrams how progressional-continuance structurally meets documentation when establishment-channels refuse to document the form: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance — the form's actual forward motion) crossed with (P)DOC (the point of idea completion of documentation — the actual material record of the form). PROG-CONT sits on the left with the subject-arrow; MT-INFO (multi-information) branches from the main line, and AFL (affinity alignment) hangs from MT-INFO. P-FC (particular focus) and SI (source initiation) branch from AFL, and so does a long line to RE-DIF (redefinitions, written 're.diff.'), which carries TRS (transition) and STF (source transfer); DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center) and RT-ALGN (reality alignment) branch from STF. (P)DOC sits as partner-axis at upper-right; SOC-RT-P (social-reality particular, written 'soc.rt. p.') hangs from the main line just before it.
